t: Universal, adjustable height strap for on-site adjustment with built-in location tabs to ensure accurate positioning. Speed prongs allow for quick, one-handed installation and square twist nail used throughout. Optional double shear nailing for greater strength. Location tab aids fast, accurate alignment with the nailing schedule stamped into the hanger. Ideal for face fix or wrap over installation and suspending solid timber from timber members. Supplied with 240 x square twist nails.
